desc:
Become a vampire in the gothic town of Velmar. Hunt by night, fly as a bat, hide from the deadly sun, and survive the Blood Moon, when the hunters come for you.

🩸 HUNT: stalk townsfolk through lamplit streets and drink to stay alive
🦇 FLY: take wing as a bat, or learn to fly as yourself
☀️ THE SUN BURNS: find shade, a roof or a crypt before dawn
🌕 BLOOD MOON: every few nights the hunters gather. Hide, slip away and live to see the dawn
🏰 BUILD: raise your own shelter anywhere, with coffins, candles and gothic relics
✨ POWERS: Blood Hunt, Mesmerism, Mist Form and more
📜 SECRETS: ten pages of a lost journal are hidden around town. Can you find them all?
🌙 NIGHT OMENS: three new goals every night, with Coins for each

Better with friends: call your coven, hunt together and survive the Blood Moon side by side.

Controls: hold E to feed · F to fly · G to build · B for the shop · C to call your friends
